gameLocalization.note: Names follow paired Canto IX part 3 records. Packaging and Great Brother tattoo aliases are resolved by IDs. Land of Illusion follows the automatic story E.G.O record. Six shared Ampule uses, unconfirmed skill Power, seal stages, and the three-turn Moses protection condition are retained separately from 9-38.

lead.text: Have the three Sinners defeat Kira and leave Matthias to the LCD team. In the final phase, stop racing for damage and protect Moses from every attack for three turns. Even with plenty of HP, a hit resets her charge.

listLead.text: Use three Sinners against the Apprentice and leave the Nursefather to allied NPCs. In the final phase, stop racing for damage and protect the designated NPC from every hit for three turns. Even with plenty of HP, a hit resets the charge.

statNote.text: Only Yi Sang, Don Quixote, and Hong Lu can deploy. All characters start at 20 SP; every Sinner and assistant shares six K Corp. Emergency Ampule uses. Damage from 9-38 does not carry over. Tables show normal 9-44 base values, excluding NPC debuffs and enemy buffs.

skillNote.text: Skills change with the seal stage. “Stamp of Complete and Total Extermination!” and “Rule Violation!” have inconsistent Power ranges and Coin values, so their Power is marked unconfirmed; use actual predictions. Atk Weight on ... Complete and Total Extermination varies.

priorities.0.text: Focus on Kira and avoid needlessly triggering the Nursefather's Counter.

priorities.1.text: Save shared Ampules for lethal hits against the LCD team.

priorities.2.text: In the final phase, stop “I'll Gut Ya Like a Fish” with a Sinner and protect Moses for three turns.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Attacks cannot finish the final phase

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: After Lævateinn is released, Ridiculous Grit reduces damage taken to 1. Stop attacking for damage and switch to intercepting attacks aimed at Moses.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: Three turns pass without ending the battle

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Check Moses's Deep Breath - Red. Hits reset its stacks, so do not ignore attacks even if her HP is high. If Kira remains alive, her attacks must also be intercepted.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: Ezra or Vespa dies and the battle is lost

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: NPC deaths also cause defeat. Check whether unnecessary ordinary Counters against Sinners are consuming shared Ampules. Aim to save about two uses for the final phase, limiting consumption through healing and enemy debuffs.

phases.0.title.text: Prepare the three required Sinners and plan shared Ampule use

phases.0.steps.0.text: Recommended Lv. 60. Prepare strong clashes and HP/SP recovery for Yi Sang, Don Quixote, and Hong Lu.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Everyone shares six Ampule uses. Save them for Ezra and Vespa in the final phase rather than spending them on Sinners taking Counters. Aim to keep about two uses.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Save E.G.O resources to beat “I'll Gut Ya Like a Fish”. Check predictions with enemy SP and buffs included, rather than judging from listed Base Power alone.

phases.1.title.text: Leave the Nursefather to the LCD team and focus on Kira

phases.1.steps.0.text: Leave Matthias to Ezra and Vespa. Use Moses's support while the Sinners handle Kira's clashes and defeat her.

phases.1.steps.1.text: “Totally Badass Ass-kicking” reuses a Coin at 4 or more I Got Praised!. Win with a strong skill and heal damage left by ordinary Counters and Unbreakable Coins.

phases.1.steps.2.text: When NPCs use Assist Defense, do not clash with the unopposed attacks left to them or equip Defense Skills on the targeted Sinner. Do not assume the same assistance is available every turn.

phases.2.title.text: Progress to unsealing without adding unnecessary Counters

phases.2.steps.0.text: Check Matthias's Counter and Great Brother tattoos. NPC attacks can lower his HP, so Sinners do not need to add every spare attack.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Check and preserve NPC responses to unsealing skills that cannot be redirected. Save healing and resources, and avoid spending Ampules on lethal damage to Sinners.

phases.2.steps.2.text: After “Lævateinn - Been a While Since I Had to Unbox the Whole Thing!”, Moses begins charging. Switch the purpose of your attacks to protecting her.

phases.3.title.text: Protect Moses from every hit for three turns

phases.3.steps.0.text: Build Deep Breath - Red to 3. Any attack that reaches Moses resets the charge and forces another protection attempt. Do not ignore attacks because her HP is high.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Check Ezra and Vespa's responses to major skills, and assign a high-Power Sinner E.G.O to “I'll Gut Ya Like a Fish”. Check targets, equipped NPC skills, and clash lines before starting combat.

phases.3.steps.2.text: If Kira is still alive, stop her attacks aimed at Moses too. One turn after the release, Hong Lu's automatic Land of Illusion removes Burn from all allies, but it does not replace protecting Moses.

phases.3.steps.3.text: Protect her for three turns to trigger the ending event. Do not try to overpower Ridiculous Grit with damage.

mechanics.0.effect.text: When taking lethal damage while another ally lives, clear Stagger and fully restore HP. Every ally's remaining count decreases by 1 simultaneously. Starts at 6.

mechanics.0.response.text: Shared by the Sinners and LCD team. Do not waste revivals needed later on unnecessary Counters.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Support equipped by Ezra and Vespa. Intercepts unopposed attacks against allies with no Defense Skills equipped.

mechanics.1.response.text: Check what is equipped that turn; do not assign clashes or Defense Skills to attacks left to assistance.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Moses's final-phase charge. Reaching 3 leads to the finish, but attacks that hit her reset the stacks.

mechanics.2.response.text: Prevent hits every turn instead of judging safety from remaining HP.

mechanics.3.effect.text: At Turn Start, inflict 5 Burn and 2 Burn Count on all characters. After the release, Matthias also gains Ridiculous Grit.

mechanics.3.response.text: Enemies gain Burn as well as allies, but keep protecting Moses instead of trying to kill the Nursefather through it.

mechanics.4.effect.text: Damage taken, including status damage, is fixed at 1. Clash wins restore SP; after losing SP through his own skills, he gains damage buffs next turn.

mechanics.4.response.text: Stop trying to deplete HP normally and complete Moses's charge.

mechanics.5.effect.text: Maximum 10. Per stack: Offense Level +1, Defense Level −2, Counter damage +5%. At maximum, damage taken +20%. Consumed by specific skills.

mechanics.5.response.text: Taking damage and crossing HP thresholds can bring major skills sooner. Save necessary clashes and healing.

mechanics.6.effect.text: Maximum 2. Blunt and Envy damage +10%; expires at Turn End. Enables effects such as Counter reuse.

mechanics.6.response.text: Avoid careless attacks against the Nursefather while he has tattoos and a Counter.

mechanics.7.effect.text: Maximum 10. Base Power +1 per 2 stacks; Slash and Blunt damage +5% per stack. Lose 1 after taking skill damage twice.

mechanics.7.response.text: Do not add Sinner attacks solely to lower it; leave him to the NPCs.

mechanics.8.effect.text: Maximum 10. Base Power +1 per 2 stacks; damage +8% per stack. Lose 1 after taking skill damage twice.

mechanics.8.response.text: Watch for “Totally Badass Ass-kicking”'s reuse condition and win with strong clashes.

mechanics.9.effect.text: Maximum 3. Blunt and Envy damage +5%; expires at Turn End. Enables effects such as Counter reuse.

mechanics.9.response.text: Restore the clasher's HP while focusing on Kira.

mechanics.10.effect.text: Skills that inflict Bleed Potency or Count also inflict Burn Potency or Count. Cannot return to OFF while the Nursefather has Lævateinn released.

mechanics.10.response.text: Defeat Kira early to simplify final-phase protection and Burn management.

mechanics.11.effect.text: A state without the additional Burn from Thermal Blades.

mechanics.11.response.text: Switches ON through I Got Praised! or the final-phase transition.

mechanics.12.effect.text: When either Middle enemy lands a skill hit, heal 7 SP once per skill.

mechanics.12.response.text: Win clashes against Kira to limit hits.

mechanics.13.effect.text: The starting state in 9-44. After “Looks Like I Gotta Unbox the Second Layer, too.”, advances to Second Seal Removed.

mechanics.13.response.text: Do not mix this with 9-38's starting state or skills.

mechanics.14.effect.text: The stage before Lævateinn's release. Uses enhanced skills such as “Stomping!”.

mechanics.14.response.text: Switch to protection after the unsealing skill.

warnings.0.text: NPC death causes defeat. Ampules do not provide unlimited revivals.

warnings.1.text: The absence of tattoos does not remove the Counter itself. Carefully choose attacks that would trigger an ordinary Counter.

warnings.2.text: In the final phase, preventing hits matters more than Moses's HP. Use Sinner clashes to stop remaining attacks.

warnings.3.text: Automatic Land of Illusion is separate from a normal manual use that spends resources. Do not count it as a selectable trump card.

preparation.0.text: Recommended Lv. 60. Level the required Yi Sang, Don Quixote, and Hong Lu.

preparation.1.text: Bring HP/SP recovery, Pierce damage against Kira, and high-Power E.G.O for the final phase.

roles.0.name.text: Clashes and focused damage against Kira

roles.0.reason.text: Reduce the enemies that can interfere with Moses before the final phase.

roles.1.reason.text: Save shared Ampules for Ezra and Vespa.

roles.2.reason.text: Handle “I'll Gut Ya Like a Fish” and protect the charge.

units.0.notes.0.text: Starts with First Seal Removed, unlike the Sealed Sword opening in 9-38.

units.0.notes.1.text: Reaching 701 HP indicates the final-phase transition. After releasing Lævateinn, gains Ridiculous Grit and targets Moses.

units.1.notes.0.text: The Stagger Threshold is 10%, rather than 9-38's 50% and 30%. Defeat her through strong clashes and focused damage instead of waiting for Stagger.

units.1.notes.1.text: If she survives into the final phase, Thermal Blades stays ON and she interferes with Moses's Deep Breath.

passives.5.effect.text: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.

passives.5.response.text: SP returns to 0. Do not expect permanent incapacitation.

passives.6.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.6.response.text: Use clashes and NPC support rather than relying on changing Panic Type.

passives.7.name.text: Am I doing this right, Papa?!

passives.7.effect.text:
Starts the stage with Thermal Blades OFF.

At Turn Start with at least 3 I Got Praised!, switch to Thermal Blades ON for the turn and additionally inflict Burn with skills that inflict Bleed.

At Turn End with fewer than 3 I Got Praised!, switch Thermal Blades ON to Thermal Blades OFF.

passives.7.response.text: Prepare for Thermal Blades ON's Burn and defeat Kira first.

passives.8.effect.text:
While the Middle Nursefather has Lævateinn, cannot enter Thermal Blades OFF.

Target the character with Deep Breath - Red.

Her animal instincts and innate combat sense tell her: whatever that is, if it hits, she will die.

passives.8.response.text: Kira targets Moses too. If she remains alive, stop her attacks.

passives.9.effect.text:
If more than two skills hit this turn, gain The Middle Styled Augmentation Tattoos next turn equal to the number of skills above two.

“Will the Middle accept me as family someday too, so I can live with all the Big Sisters and Brothers forever?”

passives.9.response.text: Restore the HP of Sinners exposed to Counters while dealing focused damage.

passives.10.name.text: Praise is the Wind in Her Sail

passives.10.effect.text:
On Clash Win, gain 1 I Got Praised!

On skill hit, gain 1 I Got Praised! (once per skill; destroyed Coins do not grant it).

If the first skill used this turn wins a clash, gain 1 additional I Got Praised! and give that skill +1 Coin Power.

passives.10.condition.text: Clash wins and hits with undestroyed Coins

passives.10.response.text: Win clashes to prevent “Totally Badass Ass-kicking”'s reuse condition.

passives.11.name.text: I'm pretty sure the Middle never forgets

passives.11.effect.text:
After taking damage from skills twice, gain 1 The Middle - Grudge and lose 1 I Got Praised! (damage instances accumulate).

At maximum The Middle - Grudge, use a powerful attack.

At Turn End, if HP is below 80%, 60%, or 40%, gain The Middle - Grudge up to its maximum.

passives.11.condition.text: Two instances of skill damage; HP thresholds

passives.11.response.text: Save strong clashes and healing for Kira's major attack.

passives.12.effect.text: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.

passives.12.response.text: SP returns to 0. Do not expect permanent incapacitation.

passives.13.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.13.response.text: Use clashes and NPC support rather than relying on changing Panic Type.

messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)9-44「キラ・マティアス（9-44）」: Kira & Matthias (9-44) guide for Limbus Company 9-44. Have the three Sinners defeat Kira and leave Matthias to the LCD team. In the final phase, stop racing for damage and protect Moses from every attack for three turns. Even with plenty of HP, a hit resets her charge.
